description: This file contains a JavaScript module that provides a singleton interface for interacting with a Supabase backend service. It includes functions to initialize and retrieve the Supabase client based on environment variables, normalize URLs to prevent configuration issues, and check if real-time features are enabled via environment settings.

methods.name: normalizeSupabaseUrl(raw)
methods.description: Normalizes and validates a Supabase URL, ensuring it uses HTTPS and has no trailing slashes.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient()
methods.description: Creates and returns an initialized Supabase client based on environment variables; returns null if configuration is incomplete or invalid.

methods.name: isRealtimeEnabled()
methods.description: Checks whether real-time features are enabled based on specific environment variables.
